distribution.narrative: Lin et al. (2025) described Anisandrus tuberculatus from western China based on type material from Chongqing and additional material from Shaanxi and Sichuan.

host_note: These host taxa are supported by direct specimen-label records. Arundinaria fargesii is retained only as habitat context because the specimen was ground-trapped in that forest, not collected ex host.
taxonomy_summary: Anisandrus tuberculatus Lin, Smith, Xu & Li, 2025 was described as a new species by Lin et al. (2025) and is the current accepted identity.

taxonomic_history.name: Anisandrus tuberculatus
taxonomic_history.note: Described as a new species; original-description p. 196.
